items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: They used to, nicknames called him Rabbit.

ctx.x: Oh hello Eddie. Eddie Summers coming in. What's it? What's it? How's it going? Well we don't want to keep you longer anyway. I think we covered those pictures pretty good I believe.

Yeah. I think this guy named him. I'm a noble one. They used to, nicknames called him Rabbit. Everybody. Oh that's Rabbit. That's Rabbit. Oh the bass drummer. Oh good. That's Rabbit. That's Rabbit. And who was the violin player?
I'm trying to think about it now. Maybe Eddie knows you. Who's that? I don't think so. This is an Orie's band.
